country.description: Target Etsy market. Sets the proxy exit country, browser locale, and search URL prefix so results match the selected region (currency, ranking, availability).
country.title: Country / Market

includeDetails.description: When enabled, attempts to visit each product page for additional details. Note: Etsy's anti-bot may block product page access in some sessions.
includeDetails.title: Include Product Details

maxItems.description: Maximum number of items to extract per URL or search query.
maxItems.title: Max Items

searchQueries.description: Keywords to search on Etsy. Each query generates a separate search.
searchQueries.title: Search Queries

startUrls.description: Etsy URLs to scrape. Supports search results, shop pages, and category pages.
startUrls.title: Etsy URLs
